<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion appears at m/z 114.06808, which matches the exact mass of C₆H₁₀O₂. This formula has a DBE of 2, consistent with a lactone (one ring + one carbonyl). A common C₆H₁₀O₂ lactone is ε‑caprolactone, whose SMILES is O=C1CCCCCO1. This SMILES is valid and fits the observed data.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C1CCCCCO1</final_answer>
